test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Ajay, Lalit, Charan, Dhruv and Gajendra are five men, who are sitting in a row facing south while Mayuri, Narmada, Shalini, Priya and Harshini are five women, who are facing north in the second row parallel to the first row. Sitting facing up.

Lalit, who is sitting immediately left of Dhruv, is facing Harshini.

Charan and Narmada are sitting diagonally facing each other.

Gajendra is facing Shalini, who is sitting on the immediate right of Mayuri in the neighborhood.

Priya, who is sitting immediately left of Harshini, is facing Dhruv.

Mayuri is sitting at one end of the row.

Who is sitting third to the right of Shalini?
solution:
Ajay, Lalit, Charan, Dhruv and Gajendra are five men, who are sitting in a row facing south while Mayuri, Narmada, Shalini, Priya and Harshini are five women, who are facing north.

1) Mayuri is sitting at one end of the row.

2) Gajendra is facing __**Shalini, who**__ is sitting on the immediate right of Mayuri in the neighborhood.

__
 
• Here **Shalini is sitting on the **** immediate right of Mayuri in the neighborhood not Gajendra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c7cd1544d30b2d3ed3f984e17d4b43aff7cd34cc4ea6ef366c8d3423db4db28.png] 

3) **Priya, who**__ is sitting immediately left of Harshini, is facing Dhruv.

 
• H**ere Priya is facing Dhruv not Harshini.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2b26ed0dc2335de2eafa6374d4a391b19ed2cc3859c53ba36085f93cdba2099.png] 

4) Lalit, who is sitting immediately left of Dhruv, is facing Harshini.

 
• **Here Lalit** is facing Harshini not **Dhruv​.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8d38cdf401bea7e05cf7a73a55225f9370928ea1a9c062d537639c122692d66.png] 

5) Charan and Narmada are sitting diagonally facing each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/810b04d7f79bca4a29189f3fc68b56781ad99796ef20185b2148e5c7435787c0.png] 

∴ Here, **'Narmada' is sitting third to right of 'Shalini'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Narmada".**
